town_description: Pasighat is the headquarters of East Siang district, Arunachal Pradesh, set on the Siang (Brahmaputra) river ~45 km from Assam. One of the state's oldest towns, it is the gateway to the Siang valley, home to the Adi Baane Kebang headquarters, the East Siang District Museum, and a Buddhist temple opposite the airstrip; Pasighat Airport serves both military and civilian traffic.
